digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler adapter seam (jira_family shared layer)
propositions: Rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center, which diverges from Cloud on REST v2 wiki/plain-text bodies, PAT bearer auth, and name-based user identity.

DC support should be an explicit shared jira_family sub-seam with contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel) rather than a forked second adapter that reaches into jira/ privates and duplicates map_fields_to_remote.

The local-to-Jira status and priority maps already exist as three drifted copies; the two adapters/ copies must be consolidated into a single jira_family definition read by ACLI, Cloud backend, and DC backend.
Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) and _loader.py must not move or change path; sharing is achieved by dependency-inverting them onto jira_family contracts.
Cloud adapter behavior must be preserved via characterization oracles committed before extraction, with the sole declared change being adopting deleted->Done in the unified status map.

The DC backend must require https for base_url unless allow_insecure is set (logging a warning), never disable TLS verification, read the PAT only from the JIRA_PAT env var, and classify resolved states against a configurable reconciler.resolved_statuses key.
